verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature docs say it can break big projects and ideas into clear, actionable tasks, which covers the work-breakdown half of the story. Nothing in the pack documents subtasks as a hierarchy, issue linking, or 'blocks / is blocked by' dependencies that would make blocking order clear. Missing for 10: explicit subtask hierarchy documentation, dependency/blocking link types, visualization of blocking order, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can break work into subtasks and link dependent tasks so blocking order is clear

citations.quote: break down big projects into clear tasks
Breakdown big ideas into actionable tasks
